To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the long-term expression, but not the short-term expression, of cocaine-induced behavioral sensitization in the rat emerges gradually after the 2nd week of age, and that the ontogenetic emergence of long-term expression of sensitization occurs in a step-wise fashion.
the long-term expression (but not the short-term expression) of sensitization to cocaine acquired before weaning begins to emerge gradually in the rat after the 1 ^{st} week of age.
the long-term retention of cocaine-induced sensitization in the rat begins to emerge gradually during the 1st postnatal week.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the mechanisms that underlie the expression of behavioral sensitizaiton to cocaine.
the ontogeny of sensitization to cocaine in the rat.
the ontogeny of the mechanisms that mediate the long-term expression, but not the short-term retention, of behavioral sensitization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mechanisms underlying long-term expression of sensitization to cocaine are not fully mature until after 3 weeks of age.

long-term expression of sensitization to cocaine in the rat is not present before the 2nd week of age, but the mechanisms for short-term retention of sensitized behavior and initiation of sensitizing effects are present earlier.

the mechanisms for the expression of sensitization to a drug of abuse are present early in development, but they are not fully developed until after weaning. (PsycINFO Database Record (c) 2019 APA, all rights reserved)
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the mechanisms of sensitization to cocaine in the rat mature incrementally in 3 phases.
the long-term expression begins to emerge after the 1 ^{st} week of age, but the short-term expression begins to appear earlier.
the mechanisms for the initiation and long-term retention of behavioral sensitization mature incrementaly in rats, with the former emerging at about 10 days of age and the latter at about 15 days.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the long-term expression and retention of sensitization to a drug of abuse begins to emerge in rats during the 1st postnatal week.
sensitization to cocaine is a complex phenomenon that emerges in the rat in a gradual and incremental fashion.
the long-term expression (but not the initiation) of behavioral sensitization is a late-maturing function.
